name: Aquarium Announcement
prompt: A one-line announcement that the Atlas Aquarium has opened, for visitors reading about sea animals. Use only on questions about the animals of the sea — ocean, reef or deep-water species, or what lives underwater. Not for any land habitat.

value.title: Discover the new Atlas Aquarium
value.text: Forty tanks from the shallows to the deep, a reef hall, and a kelp forest you walk through — now open.
